biological_replicate.evidence: inferred: 10-plex Tandem Mass Tag Proteomics (TMT Proteomics) performed on three biological replicates of EVs from cells cultured on tissue culture plastic, 25 kPa, and 0.5 kPa matrices.

experimental_design.evidence: inferred: EVs released by cancer cells on matrices that model human breast tumors (25 kPa; stiff EVs) feature increased adhesion molecule presentation (ITGα2β1, ITGα6β4, ITGα6β1, CD44) compared to EVs from softer normal tissue (0.5 kPa; soft EVs), which facilitates their binding to extracellular matrix (ECM) protein collagen IV, and a 3-fold increase in homing ability to distant organs in mice.
